remarks: MOVE IN READY! Available Immediately! Welcome to this freshly painted, well maintained End-Unit Townhouse in the quiet setting of Strawberry Woods. RARELY does a unit become available! This bright & airy home offers 2 Large Bedrooms w/double closets, Huge Loft (Sleeping/Office) & Bonus Room, providing truly additional living spaces. Main Floor offers an Eat-in Kitchen overlooking a peaceful backyard w/private Balcony perfect for dining/relaxing, a Powder Room, & spacious Living/Dining Room w/Fireplace. Upper Floor Large Primary Bedroom boasts vaulted ceiling, skylights, Balcony & shares Large Jack & Jill Full Bath w/ double sink (can be made into 2 Bathrooms) w/the Large 2nd Bedroom. Entry-level offers Bonus Room (Office/Gym/Media/Playroom) complete w/Large Storage Closet, Laundry Room & access to Below-Unit Garage w/shelving & storage. Central Air. Electrolux Central Vacuum. This manicured property offers a Community Pool, One Reserved Parking Spot & ample Visitor Parking. Primary Bedroom TV included. Amazing location! Close to Stores, Restaurants, Calf Pasture Beach/Playground/Fishing Pier/Cafe, Park Concerts, Oak Hills Golf Course. Easy access to I-95 & RR. Less than 1 mile from the Westport line. 50 miles from NY.
